static_traits.name: Wang Yikai
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with relatives and friends are affected (avoids sharing achievements)
static_traits.medical_history: Knee surgery; no other major physical illness; no history of psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent logic, neutral attitude, fairly cooperative; tending to separate emotions from cognitions, avoiding sharing private feelings with friends and family

basic_info.main_problem: I feel that being admitted to play basketball overseas is not an important achievement; this has caused me to feel inadequate and underestimate my accomplishments. These feelings began after knee surgery and recur when thinking about basketball opportunities.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize my constant downplaying of achievements is affecting my self-worth and motivation, so I am seeking counseling.
growth_experiences: After knee surgery, a tendency to downplay one's achievements began: even after being admitted to play basketball overseas, still feeling it is not an important achievement; no similar psychological problems or treatment history before, this thought repeats each time basketball opportunities come to mind and affects daily motivation.
Tall stature intensifies the above feelings: tends to attribute opportunities to height rather than personal effort, thus further underestimating their own achievements.

core_beliefs: My achievements are not important and not worthy of recognition

special_situations.event: Each time thinking about the opportunity of being recruited to play basketball overseas
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If an achievement is not one of a kind, as if anyone could do it, it does not count as a real achievement
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly reminding oneself of past efforts, but immediately negating their value, downplaying achievements
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is no real achievement; anyone could do it

special_situations.event: When talking with family or friends about his basketball achievements
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If sharing achievements would make me seem boastful, then I should not talk about them
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids discussion and plays down the topic to maintain an image of 'humility'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Talking about this feels like bragging; better not mention it

special_situations.event: Facing new overseas basketball opportunities (such as applications or tryouts)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not fully confident of proving myself well, I should not commit fully, lest I fail or be negated
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Hesitating indecisively, lowering commitment and investment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I may not be good enough; better not invest too much

special_situations.event: When reviewing the role of height in sports
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my advantages come from height rather than effort, such achievements do not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Attributes achievement to height, ignoring training and effort
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The only reason I was admitted is that I am tall

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized and have one's worth affirmed (hoping achievements as an athlete are taken seriously)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged as boastful or not good enough, and thus negated
defense_goal: Avoiding others' negative evaluations by downplaying and devaluing achievements
Maintaining surface 'humility' to reduce anxiety and failure feelings

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough young athlete needing to constantly prove oneself
object_relations.object_representation: Others who may think I am showing off and hold a critical attitude toward my achievements (family/friends/the public)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites them to affirm their achievements, conduct cognitive restructuring, or make positive self-statements
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equating self-affirmation with showing off, worrying about being judged, thus keeping a distance from emotions and replacing emotional experience with rational statements
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a gentle, empathetic, non-judgmental tone, first validating the discomfort, then connecting emotions with achievements through concrete facts, avoiding pressuring for statements.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether willing to share own achievements with family and friends or accept praise
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing others will see one as a show-off, so outward expression turns into self-repression, finding reasonable excuses for avoiding sharing
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using exploratory questioning in a gentle tone, inviting them to distinguish 'showing off' from 'genuine sharing', encouraging examining inferences with concrete examples.

manifestations: Was recruited to play overseas but feels it is not an important achievement
Views height as the source of opportunities rather than personal effort
outcomes: Hesitating to invest in career opportunities

manifestations: Avoids discussing achievements with family and friends
Distance from friends and family due to not sharing real experiences

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not sharing achievements with friends and family, turning the urge to express into self-repression
Hesitating before new opportunities, not directing energy into external action

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Overly cautious in expression for fear of seeming boastful
Frequent self-denial, measuring achievements with harsh standards

positive_force: Has been recruited to play basketball overseas, with objective strength and achievements
Able to identify and name one's cognitive biases (negating the positive, mental filtering)
Willing to try new perspectives and positive self-talk, gratitude records
Has potential support resources from family and friends
Having a history of sustained training and effort
negative_force: Persistent downplaying of achievements (negating the positive, mental filtering)
Significant feelings of inadequacy and worry about being judged as boastful
Avoiding sharing and expression leading to relationship estrangement
Hesitating indecisively before new opportunities, lowering investment
Over-attributes achievements to height and ignores effort

antecedent: Thinking of the opportunity to play overseas
Hearing others mention one's grades or opportunities
target_behavior.core_reason: Post-surgery impaired sense of self-worth, and under the cognitive biases of 'negating the positive' and 'mental filtering', attributing the opportunity to height rather than effort, thereby lowering the sense of achievement
target_behavior.function: Escaping the risk of being seen as boastful or being negated, maintaining surface safety and a 'humble' image
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased sense of self-worth, insufficient motivation, difficulty actively pursuing career opportunities

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids sharing achievements with family and friends and hesitates before career opportunities
antecedent: Scenes of interacting with family and friends
Facing new application or tryout opportunities
When invited to do self-affirmation or express achievements
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being judged as boastful by others; inner insecurity and feelings of inadequacy driving avoidance
target_behavior.function: Escapes potential negative evaluation and risk of failure
target_behavior.consequence: Estranged interpersonal relationships, missed or delayed career opportunities, persistent self-doubt
